The '''Mission to Pitann''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pitann]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' assisted the [[Kathol Republic]] in rooting out the corruption of one of its own [[Senator/Legends|senators]], [[Sho'ban Do]].
